findings: MatToQuat normalizes matrix columns and ignores translation, but no zero/shear/reflection guard or output renormalization.
Hamilton product p*q computed all temporaries before writes, safe out aliasing p or q.
AxisToQuat returns -1 without output writes when computed norm less than FLT_MIN, but squaring underflow and NaN not independently guarded.

Quat interpolation is not shortest-path; antipodal branch first writes perpendicular out, then overwrites it from p/q. Distinct out discards perpendicular; alias p/q changes inputs before blend. t==0.5 takes second branch at local0; t not clamped.
